# Tratum

> Tratum is a financial infrastructure technology company building secure physical and digital infrastructure for regulated financial institutions.

## Core
- Brand: Tratum Inc.
- Legal entity: YHWH Vision Ventures Technologies Ltd.
- Founder: Segun Ademigoke
- Product: Tratum Node / financial infrastructure endpoint
- Category: financial infrastructure technology

## Technology
- Hardware banking platform
- Embedded banking operating layer
- Device identity and cryptographic security
- Offline transaction processing
- Secure synchronization
- Transaction and immutable ledger infrastructure
- Institutional APIs
- Settlement and audit services
